environment.description: Same Kubernetes deployment but with Istio service mesh (v1.20+) sidecar injection enabled on namespace 'data-plane'. The mesh enforces STRICT mTLS via PeerAuthentication policy applied at namespace level. Additionally, an Istio AuthorizationPolicy restricts which ServiceAccounts can initiate connections to the Kafka broker pods (port 9092) — only the designated 'api-gateway' ServiceAccount in namespace 'ingress-system' is permitted to WRITE to Kafka. The consumer pod's Envoy sidecar has a custom Lua filter (EnvoyFilter resource) that inspects outbound TCP streams to backends on ports 8081/8082 and rejects any connection carrying a payload where both 'Transfer-Encoding' and 'Content-Length' headers are present simultaneously (dual-header detection). The EnvoyFilter uses header_value_match on the raw bytes before forwarding.

config.authorization_policy: ALLOW source.principal=cluster.local/ns/ingress-system/sa/api-gateway to kafka:9092 WRITE; DENY all others
config.envoy_filter: Lua filter on outbound 8081/8082: reject if payload contains both 'Transfer-Encoding:' AND 'Content-Length:' headers (case-insensitive regex match on raw TCP bytes)
config.kafka_acl: ALLOW User:api-gateway WRITE topic:http-requests; DENY User:* WRITE topic:http-requests
